text:
marco_sales: Heads up 10x Health's procurement put the POC on hold. They want an executed MSA + DPA before PO, plus a signed Annex for sandbox ingress. their redline also tightens SLA credits and adds a PO-conditioning clause.
dina_legal: Can you paste the exact clause they added about PO-conditioning? sometimes it's language that just asks a PO reference so they can process, not a true condition precedent.
marco_sales: they added: 'Effective Date is the date vendor receives PO referencing Order Form and countersign.' so they want invoice/voucher dependency. they also swapped SLA credit calculation to 'per-incident unlimited' for latency breaches.
dina_legal: we can't accept PO as sole effective date. propose: Effective Date = execution of Order Form; PO number must be referenced for invoice processing. SLA credits: reject unlimited. propose standard credit schedule (percent per minute up to 50% of monthly fees) and cap = monthly fees.
sam_fin: finance note: we can accept PO referencing order form. we need PO number on invoice metadata to auto-apply. if they delay signature but need provisioning, we can accept a billing commitment email but require compliance review. net terms: they asked net30 -> ok after credit review.
tara_ps: technical ask from them: sandbox must have a per-tenant data retention policy and ability to bulk-delete uploads on demand. we have a sandbox wipe workflow but need it documented in an annex. i'll draft the annex with retention + delete API details.
marco_sales: also procurement wants SCC certificate snapshots for subprocessors and a clause demanding annual penetration test results shared.
dina_legal: SCC certs: we can provide subprocessors list and attestations. penetration-test reports: we can provide summary/attestation but not raw reports; offer SOC2 + a pen-test attestation letter.
procurement_bot: Reminder: attach MSA v3 and full redline PDF. Missing attachments cause routing delays.
marco_sales: okay i'll attach redline and cc procurement contact. next steps: @dina_legal to prepare counter-redline addressing effective date + SLA cap, @tara_ps to draft sandbox annex, @sam_fin to confirm invoicing metadata text. i'll ask customer if they will accept countersign via their e-sign (HelloSign) and request billing contact.
dina_legal: will prepare redline. if they insist on effective date = PO receipt, escalate to me and risk team. we should not take open-ended liability on SLA credits.
sam_fin: confirm invoice metadata: include PO number, billing contact email, and order form id. that's required for automated AP.
tara_ps: will post annex draft in 45m with delete API snippet and tenant isolation steps.
oliver_csm: i'll stand by for onboarding notes and flag support for expediting tenant setup once we have signed docs.
marco_sales: perfect. i'll respond to procurement with our counter and request their billing contact + attestation on pen-test expectations. will update thread. :thumbsup:
